description: This file defines a C# class named Css that provides methods to interact with JavaScript for controlling CSS-related behaviors such as showing and hiding body overflow, using Blazor's JS interop.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class that encapsulates methods to invoke JavaScript functions related to CSS styling.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously calls a JavaScript function to show body overflow.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously calls a JavaScript function to hide body overflow and returns the result.
